research_rationale:
Read the whole order (81 FR 96329, signed 2016-12-23). It sets the order in which listed Department of Labor officials act as the Secretary of Labor under the Federal Vacancies Reform Act of 1998 (5 U.S.C. 3345 et seq.), excludes those serving only in an acting capacity and anyone not otherwise eligible, reserves the President's discretion to depart from it, revokes Executive Order 13245 of December 18, 2001, and disclaims private rights. It has no own-terms end. The three bounded searches were read against their coverage notes and return zero hits for this order: no U.S. Code note or provision (release point 119-121 through 2026-10-09), no CFR text (eCFR as of 2026-10-14) and no Office of the Federal Register disposition note names it. A search of the held corpus for the order's number finds only its own Federal Register printing and the Federal Register copy of the Department's own implementing notice, so no later instrument revoking, superseding or amending it is held. Limitation disclosed: the packet does not hold the current text of 5 U.S.C. 3345 et seq.; the Act is the order's cited authority and nothing held suggests repeal.
